verdicts.evidence: lines 950-962: both forms, all data-go buttons, Add to calendar (863-894 builds an .ics download) and Book another room have handlers; room buttons 733, catering switch 761, Try again 565. Each does what its label names.

lines 649, 715-735, 809, 846-861: rooms, features and the booking confirmation all come from api.findRooms and api.createBooking; no hardcoded records or placeholder text. Empty features show 'No equipment' (725).
lines 380-383 and 709: room step shows date, time, duration and people. Lines 391-398 and 741-743: details step shows chosen room, floor, capacity, time and people above the form.

lines 495-503: all progress lives in an in-memory state object and DOM fields; nothing is written to the URL or storage. Reload runs initWhen (964-966) and returns to step 1 with room, title and note gone. Back/Forward and server errors do keep values.
lines 354, 364, 409: defaults are 1 hour, 2 people, catering unticked. Enter submits the search (950) or the booking form the user is filling (951); no preselected option adds cost or exposure.
lines 733, 950-951: each step finishes on its own screen with one action (search, click a room, Book room); no dialogs or detours. Choosing a room advances directly to details.
lines 437 and 863-894: 'Add to calendar' with a full .ics export is the primary action on the done screen, and the brief names no calendar task. Other controls map to the brief.

lines 372, 424-425, 437-438, 564: one filled .btn per step (Find free rooms; Book room; Add to calendar); Back, Book another room and Try again use .btn.secondary; Change links are plain; room rows are unfilled.
No action deletes, overwrites or irreversibly removes anything; startOver (896-908) only runs after a booking is complete.

lines 748-771: the catering checkbox is disabled only when the room lacks catering, with visible text 'Catering is not available in <room>.' beside it (412, 757). Other disabling is only during the in-flight request (571-573, 806).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
lines 319-438, 680-681, 825-826: all visible text concerns booking; errors say 'The booking system did not respond', with no mention of implementation, mocks or the request.
lines 365, 419, 757: hints 'Include yourself.', the note example and the catering-unavailable line each sit under the control whose input they affect; no banners or disclaimers elsewhere.

line 332: 'We'll show you the rooms that are free.' explains what the step will do, under the heading rather than at a control. Lines 711-712: 'Smallest rooms are listed first.' describes the list itself.

lines 432-433 and 848: a 'Booked' pill sits directly above the heading '<room> is booked'. Line 849 lead gives date and time, which the Date and Time rows (855-856) repeat immediately below, and Room (854) repeats the heading.
lines 331-438 and all script strings: no greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks; confirmation reads '<room> is booked' (848).

line 382: button labelled only 'Change' on the room step, with no object named while criteria and several rooms are in view. Line 425: 'Back' is not a verb and duplicates 'Change room' (397). Other labels are specific verbs.

lines 488-493 and 528: feature keys are mapped to words (Video calls, Catering available); dates, durations and people counts are formatted (511-527). The id appears only as a labelled 'Booking reference' (860).

lines 678-683, 823-828: 'We could not check which rooms are free... Your choices are still here' and 'The room is not booked yet' with Try again; field errors name the fix (631-641, 789, 820). The raw ECONNRESET text is never shown.
lines 631-641, 675, 680-681, 789, 820, 825-826: messages such as 'That time has already passed. Choose a later time.' use no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', capitals or exclamation marks.

lines 688-695: zero rooms shows 'No rooms are free for N people then.' plus 'Try a different time or day, a shorter meeting, or fewer people.' directly under the still-editable search fields and above Find free rooms.

lines 672-685 vs 688-695: a failed lookup shows an error-styled notice with 'Try again'; no matching rooms shows a neutral notice telling the user to change time, length or people. Different text, style and next step.

lines 647-654, 678-683: findRooms retried once, then an in-place error with Try again, fields untouched. Lines 815-829: failed booking shows 'The room is not booked yet' with Try again; title, note and catering are kept (813, 839-843).
lines 571-582, 666, 807: on submit the button immediately gets a spinner and 'Finding free rooms' or 'Booking'. Longest wait is two lookups (about 3 seconds), well under ten.

lines 657, 666-670, 688: the notice area is cleared at the start of search and the 'No rooms are free' text is written only after the response; the room step and its count render only with results (702, 710).

lines 93, 216, 234-239, 295: overflow-wrap anywhere and min-width 0 on names, summary, heading and facts. Empty features show 'No equipment' (725); an empty note row is omitted (859); the room list is an unbounded grid (219).

No beforeunload handler and no storage anywhere in lines 481-967. Closing or leaving the page with a typed title and note (404, 418) discards them with no prompt and no restore; only in-page step changes keep them.

lines 404 and 418: title is capped at 80 and the note at 300 characters with no text stating either limit. Line 339/620: date must be today or later, stated only in the error at 632. The people hint (365) says only 'Include yourself.'

lines 410 and 417: the two optional fields are labelled '(optional)' in words; the rest are required and unmarked, with required on date, people and title (339, 364, 404) and selects that always hold a value.
lines 625-645 and 788-792: validation runs only inside the submit handlers. Lines 952-957: input and change listeners only clear an existing error, never raise one.

lines 341, 346, 366, 405, 413: each field has its own error paragraph directly beneath it, filled by setError (542-555); the field also gets a thicker border (123-126) and the message is bold text, not colour alone.

lines 668-685 and 809-830: no code clears fields on rejection; the fieldset is only disabled and re-enabled (571-581) and the catering tick is restored (839-843). Notices say the choices and details are still there.
lines 542-549: setError sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing at the message. Lines 627 and 643: focus moves to the first invalid field; 790, 818, 676 do the same for title and start time.

lines 372 and 424: submit buttons have no disabled attribute at rest. Lines 658 and 788-792: submitting incomplete input shows field messages and focuses the field. Disabled only in setBusy during the request (572).

lines 783 and 805-812: book() returns early while booking_busy and the button and fieldset are disabled with a 'Booking' label until the response. Search disables its button and fieldset the same way (666).
lines 666 and 807: setBusy swaps the label for a spinner and busy text synchronously on submit. Line 733 and 959: room choice and navigation buttons switch step immediately.
lines 833-835 and 846-861: success replaces the form with '<room> is booked' and the full booking facts. Lines 672-685, 815-829: every failure path writes a message; none is swallowed.
lines 431-440: the only success message is the confirmation screen itself, which is the sole evidence the booking exists; there are no toasts confirming something already visible.
lines 557-569: error notices with 'Try again' are rendered inline in the form and removed only when the user retries or resubmits (657, 784). No timers dismiss any message.
No action removes, archives or moves an existing item; the flow only creates a booking. Room and criteria changes are plain navigation (382, 397).

No action deletes or overwrites data, sends an unrecallable message or spends money. Creating the booking (809) follows a step that already shows the room and time (391-396) under a 'Book room' button.
No confirm(), dialog element or confirmation step exists in the file.
lines 668-702 and 809-835: the screen changes only after the server responds; there are no optimistic updates.
No modal dialogs: no dialog element, overlay or showModal call in the file.
No modal dialogs in the file.
lines 319-375: above each step's card there is only a small app name and a thin step list; the heading and task form or room list are the first and largest block (89-92, 330-333, 378-385).
lines 318-333: the page opens straight on 'When do you need a room?' and its fields; no hero, greeting or introductory panel.
No stat cards, summary metrics or charts; the only number is the count of rooms in the result line (710-712).

lines 380-384 and 709-712: the room list shows the criteria it was narrowed by as text ('<date>, <time>, N people') with a Change control beside it, and the count 'N rooms are free' above the results.

lines 339-438 and 728: every control is a native input, select, checkbox, textarea or button; rooms are real buttons. Step changes focus the h1 (931-935) and there are no click-only custom widgets or focus traps.

lines 730-732: the selected room reads 'Selected' and has aria-current. Errors carry text (132-137). Current step is bold with aria-current (78-82, 928). Unavailable catering has a dashed border plus a text hint (273, 757).

lines 557-569: error and no-rooms notices are new divs given role alert or status at the moment they are inserted into #when-notice / #details-notice (370, 422), which are not live regions. Only the busy text and room count use the pre-existing #live (327).
No accordions, disclosure buttons, custom menus, comboboxes or tabs; selects are native (345, 350).

lines 5 and 307-314: viewport meta set; under 480px the field grid becomes one column, action buttons go full width, room rows stack and fact rows stack. Main is fluid (52-56) and long text wraps (93, 216, 239).
